name: Cisco Firepower — Web C2 Beacon (Recurring Uncommon-Domain Callbacks) [host/user-scoped]
xql_query:
dataset = cisco_firepower_raw
| filter cefDeviceEventClassId = "RNA:1003:1" and act = "Allow" and request != null
| alter url_host = lowercase(arrayindex(regextract(request, "^[A-Za-z]+://([^/:]+)"), 0))
| filter url_host != null and src != null and suser != null and suser != "Unknown"
| comp count() as beacon_count, count_distinct(src) as src_hosts, values(src) as srcs, values(suser) as users by url_host
| filter beacon_count >= 8 and src_hosts = 1
| alter int_host = arrayindex(srcs, 0), user_name = arrayindex(users, 0), url = url_host
| fields user_name, int_host, url, beacon_count
description: Repeated Allowed outbound web connections from one internal host/user through the Cisco Firepower NGFW to a domain no other internal host contacts in the window — the perimeter-firewall signature of an HTTP C2 beacon. Deliberately HOST/USER-SCOPED: it carries suser (the exact box user) and the internal client IP as alert entities so XSIAM attributes the alert to the same asset/user the Cortex endpoint alerts are keyed on, letting endpoint + network fold into one case. Built on eNcore connection fields only: the domain comes from the URL (request); eNcore carries no URL category or reputation, so rarity across hosts replaces the old Uncategorized/Suspicious gate.
alert_name: Cisco Firepower — Web C2 Beacon (Recurring Uncommon-Domain Callbacks)
alert_description:
What fired: >=8 Allowed outbound connections from one internal host/user through the Firepower NGFW to a single domain that no other internal host contacted within the search window — a low-and-slow HTTP C2 beacon to uncommon infrastructure.

Why it matters: a host is beaconing to rare/uncategorized web infrastructure at a regular cadence (classic C2 check-in). Assessed severity: High.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1071.001 - Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols (TA0011 - Command and Control).

Investigate:
  - Identify the internal client (int_host) and user (user_name) and the beaconed domain (url); check domain reputation, registration age, and resolution history.
  - Pivot to the endpoint on the same host/user for the process that opened the connection (correlate with Cortex agent alerts on that asset).
  - Confirm the destination is not an expected/authorized service before escalating.

TA0011 - Command and Control: T1071.001 - Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
